parameter_selection: maximize equal-window mean delta utility per 10000 versus always normal; tie by worst-window delta, then shallower depth, then stronger L2
feature_retention: candidate versus currently retained parent: mean paired utility change per 10000 > 0 and positive change in at least 2 of 3 development windows; rejected group is not carried into next candidate
history: static customer key from first,last,normalized dob,street,5-character zip; features use only transactions at strictly earlier timestamps; same-second events mutually excluded; windows update using earlier unlabeled events; no historical fraud labels
threshold: exact utility maximum in each fold's threshold window, tied scores grouped and equal utility chooses fewer flags; always-pass/always-flag included
june: already evaluated in v1; no June score generated by this experiment until parameter and all feature-retention decisions are locked; afterwards reused diagnostic only, never selection or blind-test claim
official_test: not loaded as a feature table, no predictions or submissions
excluded: raw customer identifiers as model inputs
scope_limit: no extra grid or feature search after seeing these results; selection-window performance is optimistic and no new independent test set exists
